purpose: Challenge link-only representations of recursive Anum interpreter state and determine whether the current-link pronoun can be derived from the top context rather than stored as ambient host state.

candidateA.name: marked-frame-with-ostensive-partial-current
candidateA.closeTransition: take complete inner current, recover parentFrame, feed inner current as one value into parent current
candidateA.currentPronounCandidate: ↑ resolves to current by matching top frame K = (parentFrame ⟼ O) ⟼ current

candidateB.name: interpreted-prefix-history-spine
candidateB.topology: H_next = H_prev ⟼ abitMeaning, starting H_0 = R
candidateB.property: finite link-only state and exact replay source are available
candidateB.currentPronounCandidate: current builder is derivable only by replaying the spine; it is not a local pole of H
